_source: REAL choice-based conjoint, Preference Lead (Malur Seshadri Shridhar). HDB_Conjoint_Results_noEA_200_with_holdout_simulator_elasticity (2).xlsx, received 22 Oct 2026. 200 respondents (36 real + 164 synthetic -- see HDB_Conjoint_Design_noEA_v2-SHRIDHAR-21102026-UPDATED_FOR_ALL_200.xlsx); as of 2026-10-23 all 200 are used without distinction, 1,600 choice tasks, MNL with part-worths. McFadden pseudo R2=0.301, holdout hit rate 38% (chance=33%). per_km_closer_to_mrt and per_year_remaining_lease are an OLS fit of this file's bucketed WTP (vs. the report's 1.2km/50yr reference levels) across 4 distance/lease bands -- not a literal single conjoint output -- since the conjoint tests discrete levels, not a continuous slope; see conjoint_wtp.json for the bucketed source values this was fit from. storey_band_premium and per_additional_school_within_1km are direct level-vs-baseline WTP figures from the file's WTP tab (aggregate, all 200 respondents). per_amenity_count is DELIBERATELY OMITTED: this conjoint does not test a walkable-essentials attribute, so w_essential_sgd keeps its existing $8,000 default rather than being overwritten by an unrelated number. price_elasticity_of_choice is the file's own price coefficient (per S$100k), not a stub guess.
_not_integrated: per_year_remaining_lease has no priced term in the recommender yet -- lease is a hard floor only (min_lease_yrs), not a weighted goal. See recommender_v2.py::preference_overrides_from_file() and OPTIMISER_METHODOLOGY_REPORT.md for why this is left as a documented gap rather than a new goal term in this pass.
